topic: Are sentiment classifiers sensitive to negation words on short movie reviews (SST-2)?

trace.plan:
We will test whether sentiment classifiers are sensitive to negation words on short movie reviews (SST-2) by following these steps:
1. Load the SST-2 dataset from HuggingFace.
2. Train a logistic regression model on the dataset.
3. Evaluate the model's performance on the test set (baseline accuracy).
4. Remove negation words from the test set (e.g., "not", "never", "no") and re-evaluate the model's performance.
5. Compare the baseline accuracy with the accuracy after removing negation words to determine if the presence of negation words affects the classifier's performance.
6. Fix the random seed and perform a statistical test (e.g., paired t-test) to validate the significance of the results.
</final plan>
